children: Longsys (09976) has set the offer price for its Hong Kong listing at HK$236 per share, below the top end of the HK$240.60 guidance range, according to ETNet.

The price represents about a 44% discount to the company's A-share closing price of RMB359.63 on Thursday, Sept. 3. Longsys plans to issue about 26 million shares and has granted an over-allotment option that could increase the deal size by up to 15%. Trading in Hong Kong is expected to begin on Sept. 8. The company's A-share price rose 0.85% in early trading to RMB362.69, and its shares have more than tripled over the past year, giving it a market value of about $24 billion.

title: Longsys Sets Hong Kong IPO Price At HK$236 Per Share
